recognize_zh: 周邊血片中可見多顆中到大型淋巴細胞，胞質中等量淡藍、核圓或略不規則、染色質中度凝集，部分細胞（如下方那顆）可見單一中央核仁；在 CLL 背景下出現大量這種帶核仁的前淋巴細胞（prolymphocyte），代表疾病進展。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cells, variable in size, about 2-3 times the diameter of red cells
Moderately abundant pale blue cytoplasm with lower N:C ratio than typical CLL cells
Round to oval or slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Single central nucleolus visible in some cells, most clearly in the lower cell; less distinct in others
Red cells show normal morphology; smudge cells not evident in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increased number of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with moderately abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm. Nuclei are round to slightly irregular with moderately condensed chromatin, and several cells display a single, centrally placed nucleolus. The cells vary in size, with larger cells having more cytoplasm. In a patient with known CLL/SLL, these features are consistent with prolymphocytic progression; prolymphocyte percentage should be quantified on a well-prepared film, and TP53 status assessed.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD5+ CD23-negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14), which morphology alone cannot exclude.
SMZL cells are smaller with condensed chromatin and polar villous cytoplasmic projections, and are typically CD5-negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: Shows prominent nucleoli but with circumferential hairy cytoplasmic projections and CD103+/CD11c+ without CD25 or annexin A1.
T-PLL cells are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasmic blebs and are T-cell markers positive with TCL1A rearrangement.
